## Status as of 2026-09-19

**Status as of 2026-09-19**
- Done: #4254 corrected theory + evidence ledger (PR #4258), grip damping/stability qualification (PR #4298), contact-force regularity + acoustic bandwidth (PR #4356), handoff checkpoint (PR #4361). Article: `articles/technology-heavy-hit-impact-coupling.qmd`.
- Remaining (folded from #4255): synthesize qualified provider results (Tools #5068 children #5073/#5153/#5154/#5156/#5159/#5162; UD #9700) into the article once Tools qualifies them on protected main. No AD work is unblocked today.
- This epic is the AD mirror of Tools #5068 / UpstreamDrift #9700; Tools is the authority. Parked P3.

---

## Objective and Scientific Boundary
Determine how impact position, delivered motion, applied wrenches, shaft deformation and prestress, and grip impedance affect ball launch, club response, radiated sound and perceived sweetness. The earlier universal 99% decoupling and rigid-shaft-bound claims are withdrawn in the merged theory correction; current lumped examples do not establish those conclusions.

## Work Breakdown
- [x] #4254 — Corrected theory, primary-literature evidence ledger and full cross-repository capability inventory; merged in PR #4258 at 1ce02d7ae4d916d4c598b62be78cefa83452aaa7.
- [ ] #4255 — Synthesize qualified modeling and experimental results; report positive, null, uncertain and unavailable outcomes.

## Companion Epics
- D-sorganization/Tools#5068 owns shared mechanics, structural and acoustic kernels.
- D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift#9700 owns swing-state integration and registered studies.

## Acceptance
The theory must distinguish contact effective mass, ball impulse/energy, head rotation, hand vibration, radiated pressure and subjective preference. Derive contact mobility, finite-time coupling limits, rotating prestressed structural dynamics and vibroacoustic transfer with stated assumptions. Discuss the guitar analogy as a testable modal-damping hypothesis. Track primary-source access and limitations. Require TDD, DbC, LoD and DRY for code and update turnover records with every implementation commit.

No source review or numerical example qualifies a player-specific acoustic advantage. This epic remains open until the downstream evidence has been assessed and its limits incorporated into the theory. Numerical verification, physical validation and perceptual validation are separate gates.


## Downstream evidence checkpoint (2026-09-10)

Tools#5073 now separates instantaneous coupling, finite-duration normal motion, adaptive normal-event candidates and prescribed force/couple histories into bounded review children. Provider review issue Tools#5153 records an exact source passing406 Windows/Linux controls and independent polynomial motion/work comparisons. Its synthetic example demonstrates a possible load-to-contact pathway within the specified model; it supplies no player-specific effect size. Positive force can do negative work when its application point moves against it, so force magnitude alone must not be called a heavier or more energetic strike.

In #4255 retain the distinction between numerical verification, physical coefficients/held-out validation, calibrated radiated pressure and blinded sweetness. Full objective friction trajectories, face/hosel modes, independent convergence and matched interventions remain under the provider program. Final provider/consumer/wheel and empirical evidence remain outstanding. Keep the synthesis and epic open; do not promote these numerical results into physical or perceptual conclusions.

## Folded in from backlog triage 2026-09-19

- [ ] IA-A2: synthesize qualified Tools #5068 / UD #9700 impact+acoustic evidence into articles/technology-heavy-hit-impact-coupling.qmd once provider results are qualified (theory, grip-damping and force-regularity increments already merged: PRs #4258, #4298, #4356, #4361); do not promote numerical results to physical/perceptual claims. (from #4255)
